title: [MKT-On-site] Human Resources Manager - São Paulo, Brazil
description:
Job Summary: biwin is recruiting an HR Manager specifically dedicated to supporting our rapidly growing consumer brand business. The ideal candidate will develop and implement effective HR strategies to attract, develop, and retain talent needed for the consumer products market. This position is crucial for building a dynamic and consumer-centric team culture.

Key Responsibilities:

• Talent Acquisition:

o Design and implement recruitment strategies to attract top talent from consumer goods and retail industries

o Collaborate with department heads to determine staffing needs and job descriptions

o Establish diverse recruitment channels, including social media and industry networks

• Employee Development:

o Implement training programs to enhance consumer product sales and marketing skills

o Create individual development plans to support career growth and succession planning

o Design onboarding programs specific to consumer business

• Performance Management:

o Establish performance evaluation systems aligned with consumer business objectives

o Provide performance feedback and guidance to improve team effectiveness

o Monitor employee satisfaction and address potential issues

• Culture Building:

o Foster a positive, innovative, and consumer-centric organizational culture

o Organize team-building activities and employee engagement initiatives

o Ensure the work environment supports creativity and collaboration

• Compensation & Benefits:

o Develop competitive compensation structures to attract and retain talent

o Monitor industry compensation trends and recommend adjustments

o Manage employee benefit programs and incentives

• Compliance Management:

o Ensure HR practices comply with relevant laws and regulations

o Maintain employee records and HR documentation

o Handle employee relations issues and conflict resolution

Qualifications:

• 5+ years of HR management experience, preferably with background in consumer goods or retail sectors

• Extensive experience in recruitment, training, and employee development

• In-depth understanding of performance management and talent development

• Outstanding interpersonal skills and conflict resolution abilities

• Strong organizational skills and ability to multitask

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field

• HR certifications preferred

• Proficiency in creating positive team cultures

title: Commodity Trader - Brazil International Manager
description:
What we offer

Our client is a major Agri trader with a global operation across LATAM, Europe, Africa & APAC. We are looking for a Brazilian Agri Trader who has 4-7 years experience with a commodity trader that our client can prepare for a senior management role in Brazil. To prepare you for that they will send you on a global rotation programme across the regions to social with key stake holders over a 3 year period before you return to Brazil and joining the Country Management team.

What we are looking for

This International programme is all about preparing you to be a business leader. Our clients business is complex and fast paced, but above all is centred around relationships. The client may be a global trader, but at their heart they are a family business where relationships from the farmers, to processing & warehousing and onto ports are pivotal. We need our future leaders to nuture those relationships and create an environment that encourages an entrepreneurial spirit that is equitable and sustainable for all.

Qualifications

You MUST be a Brazilian citizen, university educated and fluent in English.

You MUST have between 4-7 years experience with a commodity trader, of which at least 2 years will be is a trading/commercial role

MUST be willingness to work overseas for 3 years

Ability to work effectively across cultures and within international teams

Excellent analytical skills, problem solving and communication skills

Integrity and commitment to ethical business practices

Think you have what it takes? We’d love to hear from you. Please click on the apply button and send us a copy of your CV in English

title: Analista de Comunicação de Incidentes
description:
*Contratação CLT

*Híbrido 3x2

*08h às 17h (Haverá plantões em escalas combinadas aos finais de semana e feriados)

Objetivo da função:

Atuar como ponto focal de comunicação em situações críticas de resposta a incidentes, garantindo clareza, agilidade e precisão na troca de informações entre equipes técnicas, stakeholders e liderança executiva.

Competências Técnicas:

  • Conhecimento sólido em TI: compreensão de infraestrutura, aplicações, segurança da informação e operações de tecnologia;
  • Domínio dos processos ITIL: especialmente nas práticas de Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management e Major Incident Handling;
  • Familiaridade com ambientes de War Room: capacidade de acompanhar discussões técnicas intensas e extrair rapidamente os pontos-chave.

Habilidades de Comunicação:

  • Comunicação oral clara e objetiva: capaz de interagir com times técnicos e executivos, adaptando a linguagem conforme o público;
  • Excelência na comunicação escrita: elaboração de comunicados, relatórios de status, post-mortems e atualizações em tempo real;
  • Escuta ativa e rápida interpretação: absorver informações complexas em tempo real e traduzi-las em mensagens concisas e acionáveis;
  • Poder de síntese: transformar discussões técnicas em mensagens estratégicas, com foco em impacto e resolução.

Perfil Comportamental:

  • Alta resiliência sob pressão: atua com serenidade em cenários de crise;
  • Proatividade e senso de urgência: antecipa necessidades de comunicação e age rapidamente;
  • Capacidade de mediação: facilita o alinhamento entre áreas técnicas e de negócio;
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes: mesmo em ambientes caóticos, mantém controle sobre o fluxo de informações.

Formação e Certificações Desejáveis:

  • Graduação em Comunicação, TI, Engenharia, Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Certificação ITIL 4 Foundation ou superior;
  • Desejável conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e ferramentas de colaboração (Teams, Slack, Jira, Confluence).

title: Especialista de Recursos Humanos (Desenvolvimento Organizacional)
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Missão do cargo:

Atuar como especialista em Desenvolvimento Organizacional e Business Partner, garantindo a efetividade do ciclo de gestão de pessoas e a construção de um pipeline sólido de sucessão. Ser responsável por conduzir e qualificar processos de performance, feedback e PDI, traduzindo dados em indicadores estratégicos que orientem decisões da alta liderança. Apoiar gestores e diretoria como parceiro de confiança, conectando iniciativas de desenvolvimento, diversidade e engajamento à estratégia corporativa, com maturidade, visão crítica e autonomia para sustentar a transformação cultural da organização.

Responsabilidades do cargo:

  • Conduzir e garantir o ciclo de gestão de pessoas - contratação de metas e avaliação de performance e comportamental;
  • Realizar Calibração - metodologia 9box; Assessment - avaliação comportamental;
  • Acompanhar e garantir feedback de desenvolvimento dos gestores;
  • PDI ( Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual) - acompanhamento dos resultados individual e em grupo, com mapeamento de ações e demandas de desenvolvimento e reconhecimento;
  • Mapa de Sucessão com nível de prontidão, com estruturação de agendas de retenção talentos e para as posições chaves;
  • Apoiar e conduzir localmente as ações de desenvolvimento dos programas corporativos: Mentoria, coaching executivo, ações internacionais, etc.;
  • Programas de desenvolvimento de times, como teambuilding, dinâmicas de grupos, etc.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Grau de instrução mínimo: Ensino Superior em Administração, Psicologia, Recursos Humanos e/ou áreas correlatas; Pós-graduação em andamento ou completo;
  • CNH B;
  • Disponibilidade para viagem;
  • Conhecimento em Excel e Powerpoint, diferencial Power BI e/ou painel de indicadores;

Desejável: Ter atuado com SAP - módulo SuccessFactors.

Benefícios:

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos 507 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 31 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 16.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Technical Service Engineer - Building Materials (Mortar Powder & Coatings)
description:
About the Role:

We are seeking a skilled Technical Service Engineer to provide expert technical support and solutions for our Mortar Powder & building material coatings product lines. This role combines hands-on field troubleshooting, customer training, and collaboration with R&D to optimize product performance and ensure customer satisfaction in construction, industrial, and architectural markets.

Responsibilities:

  • Technical Support & Troubleshooting
  • Serve as the primary technical contact for customers, distributors, and sales teams, resolving issues related to product application, performance, and compatibility (e.g., adhesion failure, curing defects, durability concerns).
  • Conduct on-site visits to diagnose problems and recommend solutions for Mortar Powder (e.g., concrete additives, mortar mixes) and coatings (e.g., epoxy, waterproofing, decorative finishes).
  • Product Training & Documentation
  • Develop and deliver technical training programs for customers, contractors, and internal teams on product usage, safety protocols, and best practices.
  • Create detailed technical documentation, including application guides, safety data sheets (SDS), and troubleshooting manuals.
  • Product Optimization & Testing
  • Collaborate with R&D and QA teams to improve product formulations based on field feedback and performance data.
  • Perform lab and field tests to validate product compatibility with substrates (concrete, wood, metal) and environmental conditions (humidity, temperature).
  • Compliance & Sustainability
  • Ensure products meet industry standards (e.g., ISO, ASTM) and environmental regulations (e.g., low VOC, REACH compliance).
  • Advocate for sustainable solutions, such as eco-friendly coatings or recycled sand powder applications.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Support sales teams by participating in client meetings, demonstrating product value, and addressing technical inquiries during pre- and post-sales phases.
  • Work with supply chain to address logistics or raw material challenges impacting product performance.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Chemistry, or related field. Advanced degrees or certifications (e.g., NACE, SSPC) are a plus. 3+ years of experience in technical service, R&D, or application engineering within the building materials, coatings, or construction chemicals industry. Sherwin williams,Sika,etc are preferred.

Required Skills:

  • In-depth knowledge of Mortar Powder applications (e.g., cementitious systems) and coating technologies (e.g., epoxy, polyurethane, acrylic).
  • Proficiency in laboratory testing methods, data analysis, and root-cause analysis for product failures.
  • Familiarity with CAD software, simulation tools, or digital tools for technical documentation is advantageous.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with green building certifications (e.g., LEED, BREEAM).
  • Multilingual skills for roles supporting global markets (e.g., Spanish, Portuguese, Mandarin).
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% for customer site visits and industry events.

title: Oliver Wyman - Jr Talent Manager - Sao Paulo
description:
Oliver Wyman is a global leader in management consulting. With offices in 70 cities across 30 countries, Oliver Wyman combines deep industry knowledge with specialized expertise in strategy, operations, risk management, and organization transformation. Our 7,000 professionals help clients optimize their business, improve their operations and risk profile, and accelerate their organizational performance to seize the most attractive opportunities. Oliver Wyman’s thought leadership is evident in our agenda-setting books, white papers, research reports, and articles in the business press. Our clients are the CEOs and executive teams of the top Global 1000 companies.

Visit our website for more details about Oliver Wyman:

Job Overview:

Oliver Wyman is seeking a Jr Talent Manager to manage a population of ~60 consultants across Oliver Wyman’s offices and Practices. This role will be responsible for their scheduling and performance management, and for personally engaging with the consultants in your group to know and understand their strengths, development objectives, personal preferences and career goals. You will also interact with Partners and Talent Managers in other parts of the business to assemble consulting teams and to remediate any issues.

The successful Jr Talent Manager will be able to proactively, delicately and empathetically balance the needs of the business alongside the preferences, career goals and development needs of the consultant to deliver appropriate staffing and talent management outcomes. You will work in a tight knit team against demanding timelines to help deliver Oliver Wyman’s business model.

This is a hybrid role that requires 3 days per week in the office. There is no option to be fully remote.

Key Responsibilities:

Talent Management:

  • Use the performance management process as a basis for engaging own consultants on development needs and areas for training
  • Develop relationships with each consultant and begin to be seen as a trusted advisor
  • Assist in directing consultants towards resources for career advice
  • Assist the consultants in escalating employee relations issues or questions around general Human Capital operations
  • Monitor for work-life-quality issues and escalate when needed
  • Collaborate with Human Capital Manager on managing the pyramid, training, onboarding, performance improvement initiatives

Project Staffing:

  • Understand at a high-level the nuances of the type of work / roles being filled
  • Liaise with project team leaders to understand staffing needs in your area
  • For assigned projects, collect all relevant details from Partners and Practice Group TMs on projects to be staffed
  • Anticipate capacity issues and manage consultants' and Partner expectations accordingly
  • Communicate staffing outcomes to consultants under your TM purview in an empathetic manner
  • Track mobility issues, holidays, trainings, background checks and other ad-hoc staffing enabling tasks
  • Ensure consultant files (bio slides, project reviews, technical skills, etc) are kept current and readily available for project proposals
  • Track your consultant’s performance, skills and development needs to help guide their growth and progression within OW

Consultant Development and Performance Management:

  • Understand the performance management framework and competency model and how it applies to own consultant's situations
  • Coordinate with the Learning and Development team on appropriate training for your consultants
  • Read all performance appraisals and follow-up any issues / performance flags with project team and manager
  • Coordinate, attend and contribute to annual Career Review meetings in for own consultant populations

Data, analysis and reporting:

  • Review weekly utilization reports, cross reference with the systems to ensure latest information is captured
  • Assist with the assembly of the project pipeline and consultant availability reports
  • Help to prepare documents and exhibits for various senior leadership meetings (using Excel and PowerPoint)
  • Assist with the analysis of performance outcome results
  • Ad hoc analyses and reporting as needed
  • Demonstrate capability in using enterprise resource management tools and performance systems
  • Maintain all employee records and keep resource planning systems up to date

Oliver Wyman Development:

  • Participate in project work within and adjacent to the broader Human Capital function on topics such as employee experience, retention, flexible working, utilization, performance, etc.
  • Organize own work and display ability to guide colleagues in building project deliverables
  • Work on cross-Practice Group, Market, Regional teams to deliver special / ad-hoc assignment in a collaborative manner
  • Be a firm citizen and embody Oliver Wyman values in day-to-day activities
  • Display a strong willingness to learn more about OW outside of the TM function by seeking out opportunities for broader involvement

Experience Required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience
  • 3-5 years of relevant professional experience in a fast-paced and dynamic client services business environment
  • Management consulting and/or Human Resources experience preferred

Skills and Attributes:

  • Proven ability to establish and grow relationships at all levels within an organization
  • Credible, highly professional, able to communicate and negotiate effectively while managing diverse personalities, cultures and backgrounds
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to tailor the message to fit the audience
  • Self-motivated and proactive; someone who takes full ownership of her/his work and is flexible to prioritize or reprioritize as needed
  • Comfortable working with data (excel, powerpoint and enterprise resource management software)
  • Creative, strategic thinker who continually seeks ways to improve processes
  • Genuinely interested in the development and career success of the consultants with whom you work
  • A strong attention to detail and high level of accuracy is required to juggle multiple projects and tasks simultaneously; as well as the ability to organize, prioritize and manage one’s day and schedule to effectively to meet deadlines
  • Comfortable working independently, but can thrive in a team setting; all while working in a fast-paced environment
  • English and Spanish Speaker

Oliver Wyman, a business of Marsh McLennan (NYSE: MMC), is a management consulting firm combining deep industry knowledge with specialized expertise to help clients optimize their business, improve operations and accelerate performance. Marsh McLennan is a global leader in risk, strategy and people, advising clients in 130 countries across four businesses: Marsh, Guy Carpenter, Mercer and Oliver Wyman. With annual revenue of $24 billion and more than 90,000 colleagues, Marsh McLennan helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit oliverwyman.com, or follow on LinkedIn and X.

Marsh McLennan is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Marsh McLennan is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh McLennan colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

title: Técnico de manutenção
description:
Você conhece a Sany do Brasil?

Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias.

Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países.

No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m2.

Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa.

Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril.

No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP.

A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.

Como nosso Técnico de Manutenção, você irá:

  • Ser responsável pela manutenção corretiva e preventiva, assim como solucionar os problemas diários de Guindastes e Linha Amarela;
  • Reportar e dar feedback a Sany periodicamente sobre todas as falhas e trabalhos realizados;

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de RH (Educação & Aprendizagem)
description:
MAIS QUE MERCADO

Somos parte de um dos maiores grupos varejistas do mundo, sendo o maior varejista do Brasil e um dos maiores empregadores privado do país, com mais de 130 mil pessoas colaboradoras, unidos no propósito de contribuir para uma alimentação mais acessível e de qualidade aos brasileiros e brasileiras.

Manifesto

No Grupo Carrefour Brasil, acreditamos que a verdadeira inclusão começa com a valorização das diferenças e a criação de um ambiente onde cada pessoa pode ser autêntica e alcançar seu pleno potencial. Aqui, cada colaborador é respeitado e incentivado a trazer sua individualidade para o trabalho.

Nossa diversidade é a força que impulsiona nosso crescimento coletivo, criando um espaço de colaboração onde todos têm a oportunidade de prosperar.

O desenvolvimento profissional é parte essencial do que oferecemos. Acreditamos que o crescimento é uma jornada contínua, e por isso fornecemos as ferramentas e oportunidades necessárias para que cada colaborador possa expandir suas habilidades e evoluir dentro da empresa. Seja por meio da escola de líderes, programas afirmativos ou vagas internas, garantimos que todos possam avançar em seu próprio ritmo, construindo uma trajetória de sucesso dentro do Grupo.

A ascensão social faz parte do nosso compromisso em transformar vidas. Valorizamos o esforço e a dedicação, oferecendo caminhos claros para o crescimento. Muitos de nossos colaboradores que iniciaram suas carreiras em posições operacionais, como estoquistas ou operadores de caixa, têm a oportunidade de, por meio de nosso apoio e desenvolvimento contínuo, alcançar cargos de supervisão, gerência e até CEO.

No Grupo Carrefour Brasil, acreditamos que o sucesso não tem limites e todos podem crescer com

dedicação e apoio. Inclusão, desenvolvimento e ascensão social caminham JUNTOS.

Aqui, você pode ser você mesmo, evoluir como profissional e transformar a sua vida e a de sua família.

Venha fazer parte dessa história!

Missão do cargo:

Responsável por liderar a estratégia de Educação Corporativa e Aprendizagem da Diretoria de Vendas e Atendimento do Banco Carrefour, garantindo a disseminação da cultura, o desenvolvimento contínuo dos colaboradores e a aderência às necessidades de capacitação dos diferentes públicos. Atuará de forma integrada com as demais frentes de RH, garantindo soluções alinhadas ao negócio e foco em performance, engajamento e experiência das pessoas colaboradoras.

Responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico junto às áreas de negócio, traduzindo suas demandas em soluções de aprendizagem que acelerem resultados e preparem a organização para os desafios futuros;
  • Engajar multiplicadores internos, instrutores e lideranças para promover uma cultura de aprendizagem contínua;
  • Liderar o desenho e a implementação de trilhas de desenvolvimento para diferentes públicos (operação de atendimento, lojas e escritório do banco);
  • Estruturar programas robustos de formação de lideranças, desenvolvimento de competências críticas e aceleração de talentos;
  • Atuar com visão de design instrucional e uso de metodologias inovadoras (blended learning, microlearning, gamificação, entre outras);
  • Liderar e desenvolver o time de educação corporativa, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo, criativo e de alta performance.
  • Estabelecer KPIs de aprendizagem, acompanhando resultados e propondo melhorias com base em dados e feedbacks;
  • Garantir a gestão eficiente de fornecedores, orçamento e ferramentas de educação corporativa.

Você precisa ter:

  • Formação superior completa (Psicologia, Administração, Pedagogia, Recursos Humanos ou áreas afins);
  • Domínio de ferramentas digitais de aprendizagem;
  • Perfil estratégico, analítico e orientado a resultados, com forte atuação junto a lideranças executivas;
  • Experiência com gestão de pessoas e vivência em projetos estruturantes de desenvolvimento organizacional e transformação cultural.

Adoraríamos se você tiver:

  • Certificações em metodologias de treinamento, design instrucional ou educação corporativa;
  • Atuação prévia em ambientes de alta complexidade, preferencialmente no setor bancário;
  • Inglês avançado para leitura e produção de materiais.

title: AWS DevOps Engineer (Temporary)
description:
Job Description

About you

You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests and be able to grow professionally.

You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in a DevOps or related role.
  • Proficiency in AWS cloud services, specifically IAM, RDS, and EKS.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools, such as Terraform.
  • Strong background in setting up and managing CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools, especially Datadog.
  • Knowledge of SOC2 compliance standards and security best practices.
  • Experience with VPN configuration, Cloud IdP (such as JumpCloud), and network security.
  • Certifications in AWS (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer) or security (e.g., CISSP) are desirable.
  • Experience with additional cloud providers (e.g., Azure, GCP) is a plus.
  • Proficiency in scripting and automation tools (e.g., Python, Bash) is desirable.
  • Familiarity with microservices architecture and container orchestration.
  • Advanced english proficiency.

You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Infrastructure Management: Manage both employee and organizational infrastructure to ensure seamless operations.
  • VPN Configuration & Management: Configure and manage VPN access to secure connections for employees.
  • Cloud Identity Provider (IdP) Management: Oversee JumpCloud or equivalent cloud IDP services for secure user management.
  • Employee Onboarding & Offboarding: Manage workstation setups, configurations, and removals during employee transitions.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Implement, manage, and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform for streamlined infrastructure deployment.
  • AWS Account & IAM Management: Oversee AWS IAM roles, permissions, and account setups for both employees and applications.
  • Database Cluster Management: Scale and manage database clusters and connectivity using AWS RDS, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Microservices Infrastructure: Maintain and optimize microservices infrastructure on AWS EKS (Elastic Kubernetes Service).
  • Monitoring & Alerting: Design and implement robust monitoring and alerting systems with Datadog to ensure proactive issue detection and resolution.
  • Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD): Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support efficient, reliable, and secure deployment processes.
  • SOC2 Compliance: Ensure all company data systems meet SOC2 standards and regularly review for compliance adherence.
  • Information and Network Security: Establish, enforce, and enhance network security measures, following industry best practices.
  • Penetration Testing & Audits: Conduct recurring penetration tests and audits as per company policies, addressing vulnerabilities promptly.

Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.

  • Celebrations

  • Great work environment

title: Vendedor Técnico Pleno e Novos Negócios
description:
Vendedor Técnico Pleno e Novos Negócios

Location: Diadema, São Paulo, Brazil (on-site, 50% at the office, 50% client visits)

Company: NOF Metal Coatings South America

NOF Metal Coatings South America, a leading multinational in anti-corrosion coating solutions for various industrial applications, is entering a new growth phase in the Brazilian and South American markets. With over 45 years of local presence and the distinction of being the only player in the sector with local production, we are now seeking a Technical Sales Professional to join our team and support the development of new markets while strengthening relationships with our existing customers.

The Role

Reporting to the local Sales Manager, the Technical Sales Professional will play a pivotal role in expanding our market presence, supporting licensees and clients, and aligning business development efforts with our strategic growth objectives. The position offers career development opportunities, including the possibility of assuming managerial responsibilities within approximately five years.

Interviews will be conducted exclusively in English. Fluency in Spanish or French will be considered an advantage.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain strong, long-term relationships with existing clients and licensees.
  • Drive business development initiatives across Brazil and South America, focusing on new markets and sectors.
  • Collaborate with OEMs and suppliers on certification processes (PPAP) and ensure technical requirements are met.
  • Provide commercial and technical support to licensees for new business opportunities.
  • Work closely with international technical-commercial teams to align strategies and share best practices.
  • Support backlog management and order follow-up for licensees.

Required Qualifications

  • 5–10 years of experience in B2B technical sales, ideally in the industrial or chemical sector.
  • Strong background in the automotive industry, preferably with certification/PPAP processes or special coatings/chemical products.
  • Fluent English (oral and written) is mandatory; Spanish or French is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Metallurgical, or Chemical Engineering, or in Business Administration.
  • Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Office; knowledge of Power BI and ERP systems is an advantage.
  • Demonstrated ability to work autonomously while collaborating across international teams.

Personal Profile

  • Dynamic, proactive, and resilient personality with strong customer orientation.
  • Availability for short business trips within Brazil and South America.
  • Ambition to grow into managerial responsibilities within five years.

Employment Details

  • Contract: Full-time, CLT
  • Industry: Chemical Manufacturing

title: Analista de contabilidade sênior
description:
Sobre nós

Somos a Forvis Mazars, com mais de 80 anos de expertise global e mais de 20 anos de presença no Brasil. Presente em mais de 100 países, nossos colaboradores estão a postos para apoiar sua empresa com serviços de Auditoria, Consultoria e BPO reconhecidos pelo mercado no Brasil e no mundo.

Como é atuar conosco

Por meio da nossa área de Staff Loan, você poderá colocar sua experiência em prática em contextos empresariais variados, contribuindo com nosso padrão de excelência em distintas operações e segmentos.

Ao ser alocado em uma de nossas demandas externas, você terá a oportunidade de atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e desafiadores, colaborando diretamente para o sucesso de nossos clientes. Essa contribuição proporciona vivência prática e aprendizado constante. E você contará com o acompanhamento próximo da equipe Forvis Mazars, garantindo alinhamento ao longo de toda a sua atuação.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Realizar análises de resultados, identificando variações entre real x real e real x orçado, assegurando que todas as despesas estejam contabilizadas na competência correta;
  • Executar processos de fechamento contábil;
  • Efetuar análises patrimoniais;
  • Realizar conciliações contábeis diversas de contas patrimoniais (ativo e passivo);
  • Efetuar lançamentos contábeis, incluindo provisões e reversões;
  • Atuar em auditorias internas e externas;
  • Elaborar e revisar demonstrações financeiras;
  • Cumprir obrigações acessórias, como ECD, IBGE e Bacen;
  • Utilizar o sistema Protheus (diferencial);
  • Aplicar recursos avançados de Excel para análise e controle de informações.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo em Ciências Contábeis;
  • Experiência sólida nas áreas de contabilidade e controladoria;
  • Conhecimento em conciliações contábeis, fechamento contábil e análise de contas patrimoniais;
  • Vivência com auditorias internas e externas;
  • Conhecimento em demonstrações financeiras e obrigações acessórias (ECD, IBGE e Bacen);
  • Domínio de Excel avançado;
  • Desejável experiência com sistema Protheus.

O que esperamos de você

  • Comprometimento com prazos, entregas e qualidade do trabalho;
  • Capacidade de adaptação a diferentes ambientes e rotinas corporativas;
  • Proatividade na resolução de problemas e execução das atividades;
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Responsabilidade, organização e adaptabilidade;
  • Disposição para colaborar com diferentes equipes e projetos.

Benefícios

  • Rede de academias;
  • Canal de apoio psicológico;
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida.

title: Salesforce Analyst
description:
Company: RevBlack

Location: Hybrid (3 days in-office – Curitiba, 2 days remote)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Mission: Why we exist, What we do and Why we need you

RevBlack exists to revolutionize revenue operations, turning CRM systems into engines of growth and efficiency. We specialize in optimizing Marketing Ops, Sales Ops, and RevOps using tools like HubSpot and Salesforce to deliver scalable, data-driven solutions for our clients.

RevBlack is not for everyone. It’s for the curious, fast learners who take ownership and thrive on high standards. We work hard, move fast, and deliver work that makes a difference. If you’re seeking an easy job, this isn’t it. But if you’re ready to push your limits and grow, we want you.

We need a Salesforce Specialist to drive client success by implementing CRM solutions, optimizing processes, and providing insights that fuel revenue growth. You will leverage your expertise to implement and optimize CRM systems, significantly improving our clients’ operational efficiency and revenue generation, becoming an integral part of their success.

  • Drive Client Revenue Growth: Implement and manage CRM solutions that lead to measurable revenue increases.
  • Optimize Operational Processes: Streamline revenue operations to enhance efficiency and reduce costs.
  • Maintain Data Integrity: Ensure CRM data accuracy for informed decision-making.
  • Provide Strategic Recommendations: Analyze data to offer insights that boost client success.
What we’re looking for
  • Communication Excellence: Outstanding verbal and written English skills are mandatory for this position.
  • CRM Mastery: Proven experience with Salesforce.
  • Operational Expertise: Deep knowledge of sales, marketing, and customer success operations.
  • Analytical Prowess: Strong skills in data analysis and process optimization.
  • Project Leadership: Ability to manage complex projects with accountability.
  • Adaptability: Thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Why Join RevBlack?
  • Be part of a dynamic and innovative team that delivers high-quality, impactful work tailored to our clients' needs.
  • Enjoy a flexible work environment with a hybrid modality, competitive salary, and benefits like unlimited PTO.
  • Take advantage of significant opportunities for career growth, with a strong focus on continuous learning and skill development.
  • Work in a transparent and communicative culture where clarity and collaboration are key to success.

If you’re ready to make a difference in the RevOps world, apply now to join RevBlack.

title: Senior Recruiting Team Lead - Pharmaceutical
description:
At Hudson RPO, we embrace curiosity, think differently, and shape the future of talent.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead and oversee the recruitment team supporting one of our major clients in the pharmaceutical industry.
  • Manage end-to-end recruiting processes across multiple functions and seniority levels, ensuring delivery of high-quality candidates.
  • Develop and implement strategic sourcing and recruitment strategies to attract top talent in the pharmaceutical sector.
  • Mentor and coach junior team members, fostering a collaborative and high-performance environment.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with hiring managers and stakeholders, providing insights and guidance throughout the hiring process.
  • Monitor team performance metrics, streamline processes, and continuously improve recruitment efficiency and candidate experience.
  • Collaborate with client leadership to align recruitment strategies with organizational objectives and talent needs.

You’ll be someone who can bring:

  • 5+ years of recruitment experience, with a strong background in the pharmaceutical industry.
  • Proven leadership and team management skills, with experience leading or mentoring recruiting teams.
  • Successful track record in managing full-cycle recruitment for diverse roles and seniority levels.
  • Expert knowledge of sourcing strategies, talent pipelines, and tools (ATS, LinkedIn Recruiter, etc.).
  • Excellent relationship management and stakeholder influencing skills.
  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects efficiently.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English, both spoken and written.

About you:

  • You are a proactive leader with a strategic mindset and a passion for talent acquisition.
  • You excel at coaching, motivating, and developing team members.
  • You are adaptable, metrics-driven, and thrive in fast-paced, hybrid environments.
  • You have excellent communication skills and a deep understanding of the pharmaceutical industry landscape.
  • Location: São Paulo, Brazil — hybrid role (office and remote work).

Why you’ll love working for Hudson RPO:

  • Lead impactful recruiting projects with some of the world’s premier pharmaceutical companies.
  • Work in a flexible, inclusive, and values-driven environment.
  • Be recognized and rewarded for your leadership and team achievements through quarterly and annual programs.
  • Join a passionate, innovative team dedicated to shaping the future of talent.

A little bit about us:

At Hudson RPO, we are shaping the future of talent. From recruitment process outsourcing to employer branding and across the complete talent lifecycle, we are passionate about delivering world-class customer and candidate experiences. We support organizations globally with innovative, customized recruitment and talent solutions. Our people are smart, collaborative, and forward-thinking — empowered by inclusive leaders and united by our shared goal of delivering excellence for our clients.

Hudson RPO is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, clients, and candidates.

Ready to start your journey with Hudson RPO?

Apply now! Want to learn more about life at Hudson RPO? Visit our website.

title: Analista de Tesouraria Sênior Bancária

Nascida em Milão no ano de 2003, temos uma história de crescimento exponencial. De 44 pessoas, hoje somos mais de 4500 em todo o mundo, presentes em 4 continentes e em mais de 14 países. Ao longo de todos esses anos crescemos significativamente e transformamos milhares de pessoas através do nosso trabalho!

Espelha o desejo de evolução constante e perenizarão da empresa através de uma cultura forte centrada em pessoas e que essas pessoas pratiquem constantemente a ownership. Que para nós significa liberdade com autonomia de dono e responsabilidade pelo futuro da organização.

Significa ter e desenvolver constantemente, internamente ou através de parceiros, soluções inovadoras que promovam impactos em nossos clientes e que sejam o pilar de nossa perenidade. Pois só um repensar constante nos manterá atuantes no mercado.

Conscientes dos aspectos sociais do nosso país, transformamos o nosso conhecimento, a nossa capacidade de execução e networking em impactos positivos e constantes.

Para realizar nossos sonhos, alcançar nossa visão e honrar o porquê existimos, precisamos fortalecer muito bem quem nós somos. Nunca esquecendo da nossa autenticidade e da nossa singularidade.

title: Investment Banking | Intern Position (São Paulo)
description:
Euro Latina Finance

Established in early 2010 by the former Global Head of M&A at Groupe Casino (1998 - 2010), Euro Latina Finance is a French truly independent financial advisory firm specialized in cross-border transactions between Europe and Latin America.

With fully operational regional offices and local teams in Paris, São Paulo, and Bogotá, Euro Latina Finance provides tailor-made M&A and strategic advice to a portfolio of international blue-chip clients. We specialize in cross-border M&A transactions between Europe/US and Latin America ranging from US$200mm – US$1bn+, across a wide array of sectors.

Since its inception, Euro Latina Finance has advised 28 successful transactions on a total of c. 60 M&A projects, including some of the most complex, transformational, and landmark cross-border deals into/from Latin America such as the acquisition of Walmart Brasil by Advent (US/Brazil), the restructuring of Vale New Caledonia (France/Brazil) or the advisory of French industrial laundry group Elis’ on its build-up strategy in LatAm (8 transactions of all sizes advised over 8 years).

Description of the Position:

The Location: São Paulo office located in Itaim Bibi

The Role: M&A Intern

The Intern will be involved in the origination and execution of mergers and acquisitions transactions, including the following tasks: preparation of internal and client presentations (pitches, company profiles, teasers, CIM,...), participation in financial and valuation analysis, participation in meetings or calls with international clients along with the senior team from Euro Latina Finance.

Who are we looking for?

Candidates motivated to work in a dynamic, challenging, multicultural and fast-paced professional environment, holding sharp analytical skills and able to manage various transactions simultaneously.

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the team and different clients across the globe, capable of fostering strong networking, contributing to a highly valued positive culture
  • Diligent and intellectually curious with a strong work ethic and a drive to succeed
  • Rigorous, hard-working, highly motivated, and skilled team-player who can demonstrate analytical skills and engagement to the team and to our clients

Qualifications

  • Full availability to work in our São Paulo office (Itaim Bibi), as this is a 100% on-site position
  • High academic credentials from a leading business and/or engineering school and/or top-tier university
  • Solid background in finance and accounting, exceptional sense of rigor and attention to details and ability to work efficiently under time pressure
  • Previous experience in an IB or PE firm is a preferred qualification
  • Fluency (writing, reading, and speaking) in Portuguese and English (French and/or Spanish would be highly valued)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Superior level of command of MS-Office Tools, namely Excel and PowerPoint
  • Expected graduation in Jul/26, Dez/26 or later

Why Euro Latina Finance?

  • You will be part of a global and multicultural team that is based in three different locations across Latin America and Europe and is led by its founder and CEO
  • Play a key role and contribute to the transformational phase of a growing and recognized M&A advisory firm with a solid pipeline and strong deal flow
  • High exposure to a vast array of sectors, top-notch companies, and deal complexity, in a multi-language and cultural environment
  • Runway to grow in a dynamic, unbureaucratic, challenging, and collaborative environment, with great potential for professional development and career promotions

title: Accounting Coordinator - South America
description:
FERRAGAMO

Accounting Coordinator – South America (Brazil, Chile, and Argentina)

Work location: São Paulo, SP, Brasil

About the Role

We are a leading company in the luxury retail industry, and we are looking for a highly skilled and detail-oriented Accounting Coordinator to join our South America Finance team. This position will be responsible for supporting the accounting and tax closing processes across Brazil, Chile, and Argentina, ensuring compliance with both local regulations and international accounting standards (IFRS).

This is a strategic role that requires strong technical expertise, communication skills, and the ability to interact with both local and international stakeholders, including external auditors and consultants.

Key Responsibilities

Closing & Management Reporting

  • Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual accounting and tax closing activities in collaboration with internal teams and BPO partners.
  • Monitor financial entries throughout the month and resolve operational or system-related discrepancies.
  • Prepare, review, and submit financial reports using HFM, adhering to headquarters' consolidation timelines.
  • Deliver complete and accurate Reporting Packages to HQ on a regular basis.
  • Submit monthly cash flow reports in HFM.
  • Manage IFRS 16 processes and coordinate related entries with BPOs based on HQ guidelines.
  • Maintain provision spreadsheets for bonuses, commissions, variable rent, and other expenses.
  • Review balance sheet reconciliations and ensure accuracy with BPO partners.
  • Support external audits and Transfer Pricing reviews.
  • Provide ad hoc financial analyses and account breakdowns as requested.
  • Collaborate with global teams to clarify technical accounting queries and validate classifications.

Inventory Control

  • Execute monthly inventory account reconciliations, including corrections and reclassifications.
  • Calculate and manage inventory obsolescence provisions across all countries.
  • Support cost closing processes and perform margin analysis.
  • Reconcile intercompany transactions and inventory-related accounts.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Mandatory: Experience with Linx ERP.
  • Preferred: Familiarity with HFM and other ERP systems.
  • Strong background in accounting/tax closing and IFRS compliance.
  • Experience in multinational companies and reporting to global headquarters.
  • Advanced Excel skills and high proficiency in data management and analysis.
  • Excellent analytical and communication skills.
  • Languages: Intermediate to advanced English and/or Spanish.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to join a prestigious luxury retail brand with a strong international presence.
  • Hybrid work model. (São Paulo, SP, Brasil)
  • Enhanced benefits package.
  • Group Spanish lessons offered as part of your professional development.
  • Exposure to global finance operations and opportunities for career growth within a multinational environment.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and apply directly to this posting.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
We're Hiring: Senior Project Manager - Luxury Interior Fit-Out

Location: KSA & UAE Based Projects

ALEC FITOUT, a division of ALEC Holdings and part of the Investment Corporation of Dubai (ICD), is a leading specialist in high-end interior fit-out and refurbishment projects across luxury hospitality, cultural, and themed entertainment sectors. We bring visionary interiors to life through precision execution and world-class craftsmanship.

We’re looking for a Senior Project Manager with a strong background in luxury interior fit-out projects to manage and oversee multiple high-profile projects in KSA and UAE. This role will involve leading a team of professionals, ensuring the delivery of world-class interior fit-outs from concept to completion. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in managing complex, high-spec interior projects, with a proven track record of delivering exceptional quality, on-time and within budget.

  • Please note that this role will be assigned to ALEC FITOUT projects located either in the Saudi Arabia (KSA) or the United Arab Emirates (UAE).
  • The position requires a six-day working week, which is mandatory for all site-based roles.
  • Successful candidates must be eligible to obtain a work visa for either KSA or UAE.

Your Role:

  • Lead and manage luxury interior fit-out projects from concept to flawless delivery.
  • Oversee planning, procurement, budgeting, and execution.
  • Align cross-functional teams, subcontractors, and consultants toward excellence.
  • Champion HSE standards, risk management, and quality assurance at every phase.
  • Be the driving force behind timely approvals, smooth coordination, and design perfection.

What You’ll Need:

  • 15+ years’ experience in construction, with at least 5 in luxury fit-out project management.
  • Strong portfolio managing complex, high-spec interior projects.
  • Proven ability to handle multiple concurrent projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or related.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Core Technical Skills:

  • Fit-Out Project Execution
  • Project Lifecycle Management
  • Luxury Interiors
  • Contract & Commercial Management
  • Stakeholder Coordination

Please ensure to attach your CV in English when applying.

title: Principal Installation Analysis Engineer 25003289
description:
Job Overview:

The Principal Installation Analysis Engineer is responsible for interpreting internal or external business issues and recommending best practices. They will be tasked with solving complex Installation Analysis-related problems and will work independently with minimal guidance. The Principal Installation Analysis Engineer may be responsible for leading functional teams or projects and is regarded as a specialist in Installation Analysis. As such, they must have in-depth expertise in Installation Analysis as well as broad knowledge of the Installation Analysis discipline within the Engineering function.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Perform conceptual, FEED, and detailed analyses and design as per design basis, project specifications, design codes, and standards
  • Apply in-depth skills and broad knowledge of the business to address complex problems and nonstandard situations
  • Prepare clear and accurate detailed design calculations and analyses including design reports and - procedures
  • Manage own time to meet objectives and (as Lead Engineer) forecast and plan resource requirements
  • Communicate and explain difficult concepts and persuade others to adopt a point of view
  • When acting as Lead Engineer, in addition:
  • Direct an Engineering team as a Lead Engineer
  • Lead the Discipline engineering design of the assigned work area and complete it within the planned schedule and budget, in accordance with standards, MDR, and project-specific procedures and to a high professional standard
  • Plan, organize, and direct all aspects of Discipline execution on the assigned project including scope, deliverables, schedule, and all manpower resources - agree allocations with the Discipline Manager
  • Ensure interfaces and deliverables are clearly identified
  • Maintain responsibility for progress and productivity, identifying any required corrective action
  • Act as project representative for Discipline during meetings with the Project Team, Customer discipline lead, and relevant agencies such as certifying authorities, auditors, third parties, etc.
  • Become fully familiar with the project scope of work, specifications, schedule, and all inter-discipline requirements; including identifying concerns as early as practicable and taking appropriate initiatives to address issues, interpreting contractual requirements as they relate to engineering execution
  • Identify changes to scope and promptly raise change notifications, including providing any necessary supporting documentation and estimates Provide similar support for variation orders
  • Interface with all disciplines to develop clash-free designs
  • Interface with other departments to obtain input for discipline designs and drawings
  • Maintain close coordination with other engineering disciplines, Planning, fabrication, Marine, and Project Management Teams, as required
  • Document substantive communications (communications that result in significant decisions or assignment of actions) and forward copies to Discipline Lead Engineer and Discipline Manager
  • Prepare estimates for bid proposals, including technical query reviews, execution statements, and manhour estimates, identifying software requirements and any other project-specific requirements
  • Raise technical queries to obtain missing information, clarify work scope, and maintain preferred McDermott procedures, specifications, standards, practices, and operational requirements
  • Prepare, review, and (as Lead Engineer) approve engineering design basis, philosophies, and technical specifications
  • Participate in finalizing deliverable lists and deliverables, ensuring compliance with specifications and functional integrity
  • Review project schedule and fabrication schedule in relation to construction sequence, milestones, and engineering scope
  • Attend project kickoff and review meetings, vendor meetings, engineering meetings, and offshore site surveys, as required
  • Provide technical direction and review of Designers producing products related to Installation Support Engineering
  • Prepare, review, and (as Lead Engineer) approve design reports and procedures
  • Assist in providing necessary design inputs to other disciplines to enable them to proceed with their deliverables
  • Assist procurement personnel in procuring discipline equipment, materials, and services; ensuring that work produced complies with Customer objectives and procedures Procurement assistance includes preparing, reviewing, and (as Lead Engineer) approving requisitions, evaluating technical quotations, and preparing queries, compiling bid tabulations and recommendations, preparing purchase requisitions, and coordinating with Procurement to expedite vendor documents, as directed by Discipline Lead Engineer
  • Assist in updating weight report based on receipt of vendor information
  • Review and (as Lead Engineer) approve vendor and subcontractor submittals, checking for compliance with project specifications and providing comments as necessary
  • Review and (as Lead Engineer) approve design verification through single-discipline check /inter-discipline check (IDC)
  • Provide technical support to all fabrication queries, including identifying defect/rectification requirements
  • Keep the Discipline Manager and Project Management Team apprised of all activities and concerns, technical, budgetary and manpower related
  • Assist in providing inputs for actual, planning, and forecasting progress reports including associated productivity
  • Check final subcontractor and vendor data manuals to ensure that all requested data has been received and approved
  • Present issues and problems to Customers in a timely manner and assist the Lead Engineer in negotiating resolution in accordance with project and company requirements
  • Perform (as required) Technical Quality Audit reviews in accordance with MDR Global Procedures
  • Assist Lead engineer with responses to Customers and other agencies (such as certifying authorities, auditors, third parties, etc.) on their review and approval
  • Capture lessons learned and enter into MDR’s Lessons Learned system
  • Guide less experienced engineers on MDR and Discipline procedures, standards, worksheets, auditors, third parties, etc.) on their review and approval
  • Supervise and guide assigned engineers and coordinate with Lead Designers for Discipline engineering and design deliverables
  • Responsible for the engineering integrity of the assigned work area
  • Monitor costs of own work processes
  • Assist in the maintenance of departmental technical guidelines and standard calculation notes
  • Participate in development and maintenance of Global Procedures, Software, and Standards
  • May participate in standards development committees or task groups such as API
  • Develop communication and presentation skills (e.g., write technical papers, participate in conferences and/or seminars, present design solutions, and/or present topics at ‘lunch and learn’; etc.)
  • Identify and provide training to staff in specific techniques and proprietary software
  • Provide information on employee performance to the Discipline Manager
  • Assist the Discipline manager in interviewing job applicants
  • Perform, review, and (as Lead Engineer) approve Pipeline Installation engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures for loadout, transportation, and installation (including installation aids):
  • Submarine pipelines
  • Risers
  • Spools
  • PLETS and manifolds
  • Cables
  • Perform, review, and (as Lead Engineer) approve Structural Installation engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures for loadout, transportation, and installation (including installation aids) of offshore structures, including barge upgrades/modifications
  • When acting as Lead engineer, in addition:
  • Act as project-based discipline point of contact in communications and meetings with customer counterparts
  • Ensure substantive communications are documented
  • Prepare bids and projects discipline engineering budget and execution plans
  • Identify project staff needs based on knowledge of individual engineer’s skill sets and provide requests to the discipline manager
  • Plan, organize, and assign tasks, responsibilities, and manhour budgets to the discipline team, and verify tasks are completed within budgets
  • Plan discipline deliverable schedule/register compliant with the overall execution plan
  • Prepare work forecasts identifying change management plans, corrective action, and real-time schedule
  • Provide discipline inputs for actual, planning, and forecasting progress reports including associated productivity

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Naval Architecture, Civil/Structural/Mechanical Engineering (Master’s is a preference)
  • 15-20 years of experience in oil and gas with a major contractor or consultant predominantly performing construction and installation design
  • Detailed knowledge of design techniques and analysis methods, and detailed knowledge of the theory, content, and application of standards, codes, and guidelines as applicable Knowledgeable in project coordination and execution skills
  • Preferably Registered Professional Engineer or member of a professional engineering society

title: Gerente de loja de varejo
description:
Descrição da vaga

Se você é uma pessoa determinada, comprometida e com experiência na área de varejo, esta vaga de Gerente de Supermercado pode ser a oportunidade perfeita para alavancar sua carreira. Estamos em busca de um profissional qualificado que possa liderar nossa equipe e impulsionar o sucesso do nosso supermercado.

Responsabilidades

Como gerente de supermercado, você será responsável por liderar a equipe e garantir que todas as operações diárias sejam realizadas de forma eficiente e eficaz. Isso significa que você terá que supervisionar o trabalho dos funcionários, delegar tarefas e garantir que todos estejam desempenhando suas funções corretamente.

Além disso, será sua responsabilidade garantir que o estoque esteja sempre abastecido e organizado, controlando inventários e realizando pedidos quando necessário. Você deve se certificar de que os produtos estejam em boas condições e dentro da validade, para garantir a satisfação dos clientes.

Como gerente, você também deverá lidar com situações delicadas, como reclamações de clientes insatisfeitos ou conflitos entre membros da equipe. É fundamental ter habilidades de comunicação eficazes e saber resolver problemas de forma rápida e justa.

Por fim, como gerente de supermercado, você será o representante da empresa perante a comunidade. Isso significa que você deve estar preparado para interagir com clientes, fornecedores e outros parceiros comerciais de forma profissional e cortês.

Qualificações

1. Experiência no ramo varejista no mínimo 3 anos : Para se destacar como gerente de supermercado, é fundamental ter experiência prévia no setor varejista. Isso inclui a compreensão das operações do supermercado, como o controle de estoque, gestão de compras e logística.

2. Habilidade em liderança: Ser um bom líder é crucial para o cargo de gerente. Você deve ser capaz de motivar e inspirar sua equipe a alcançar metas e garantir a satisfação dos clientes. Isso requer habilidades em comunicação eficaz, resolução de problemas e tomada de decisões assertivas.

3. Conhecimento em gestão financeira: Como gerente, você será responsável pelo orçamento do supermercado e pelo controle das finanças. Ter conhecimentos sólidos em gestão financeira ajudará a tomar decisões estratégicas para otimizar os lucros e reduzir custos desnecessários.

4. Capacidade organizacional: A gestão eficiente do tempo e a capacidade de organizar tarefas são fundamentais para o sucesso como gerente de supermercado. Você precisa ser capaz de desenvolver cronogramas eficientes, delegar responsabilidades adequadamente e manter uma operação suave e eficiente.

5. Habilidades em atendimento ao cliente: Ser capaz de lidar com os clientes de forma amigável e cortês é essencial para garantir a satisfação do cliente. Como gerente de supermercado, você deve ter habilidades em atendimento ao cliente para resolver problemas e lidar com situações delicadas.

6. Conhecimento sobre regulamentações sanitárias: Supermercados precisam cumprir uma série de regulamentações sanitárias para assegurar a qualidade e segurança dos produtos comercializados. Ter conhecimento sobre essas regulamentações é importante para garantir que o supermercado esteja em conformidade com todas as normas.

  • 7. Flexibilidade e adaptabilidade: O setor varejista está em constante mudança, exigindo que os gerentes sejam flexíveis e capazes de se adaptar rapidamente às novas tendências e demandas do mercado. A capacidade de se ajustar a diferentes situações é uma característica importante para um gerente de supermercado bem-sucedido.

title: Logistics Innovation Senior Manager LATAM
description:
Job Title: Logistics Innovation Senior Manager LATAM | Samsung Electronics

Highlights:

  • Location: São Paulo - SP
  • Type of contract: Permanent contract, Full time
  • Work Modality: On Site

Who are we?

Samsung Electronics has grown into one of the world’s leading technology companies, recognized as one of the top 5 global brands. As a global leader in technology, we are transforming the world with the creativity and diversity of our talented people who drive this transformation.

Our company's success reflects the determination and talent of our people, aligned with our key corporate values: People, Excellence, Change, Integrity, and Co-prosperity. Our mission is to help people achieve the impossible.

We are inspired by what people want to accomplish in their lives and work to create products that empower them in new ways. This drive fuels our innovation.

Join us at Samsung and find your opportunity to do what you can't.

Looking for more? Visit our website or our career page HERE!

Job Description

The professional will play a transformative role in defining and deploying Samsung's Logistics Strategy for Latin America (Brazil, Mexico, Chile, Colombia, Peru, Panama, Miami) for Finished Goods (all product lines) and Spare Parts operations. Key programs to be carried out by this position include:

  • Long-Term Capacity Planning: Process Implementation and Improvement: Logistics Network Design, Warehouse Infrastructure (including automation projects), Transportation Modes, etc.
  • Cost Efficiency Program: Manage the project pipeline (PMO) and lead analyses to identify new opportunities for operational efficiency improvements and cost savings (productivity increases for warehouse handling and transportation, warehouse storage efficiency, lead time reductions, LSP management, etc.).
  • Process Innovation: Apply problem-solving skills and an innovative mindset to create, redesign, and implement processes and tools that support logistics operations optimization and better governance in Latin America (planning, control, analysis).

Key Job Responsabilities

  • Collaborate on the definition and deployment Samsung’s logistics strategy for Latin America, covering Finished Goods and Spare Parts operations across key markets (Brazil, Mexico, Chile, Colombia, Peru, Panama, Miami).
  • Implement and improve the “Long Term Capacity Planning” process, focusing on logistics network design, warehouse infrastructure (including automation projects), and transportation modes.
  • Manage the project pipeline (PMO) for the “Cost Efficiency Program.”
  • Lead analyses to identify new opportunities for operational efficiency improvements and cost savings, including:
  • Productivity increases for warehouse handling and transportation.
  • Warehouse storage efficiency enhancements.
  • Lead time reductions.
  • Strong collaboration with Procurement and other stakeholders.
  • Apply problem-solving skills and an innovative mindset to create, redesign, and implement processes and tools that optimize logistics operations and improve governance in Latin America.
  • Focus on areas such as planning, control, and analysis to support logistics optimization.
  • Work closely with internal teams, suppliers, and external partners to ensure seamless logistics operations across Latin America.
  • Foster strong collaboration with Procurement, IT, and other departments to drive efficiency and innovation.
  • Track key performance indicators (KPIs) to evaluate logistics performance and identify areas for improvement.
  • Prepare detailed reports on logistics operations, cost-saving initiatives, and process innovations for senior management.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and best practices to enhance logistics processes.
  • Lead initiatives to innovate and improve logistics strategies, ensuring adaptability to changing market conditions and customer demands.
  • Communicate effectively with stakeholders to address concerns, implement solutions, and ensure alignment with organizational goals.
  • Provide leadership and guidance to teams involved in logistics operations and strategic initiatives.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering or a related field.
  • Proven experience in logistics, supply chain management, or related fields.
  • Experience in logistics operations and/or projects across Latin American countries (e.g., Brazil, Mexico, Chile, Colombia, Peru, Panama, Miami; not necessarily in all of them).
  • Experience in network design projects and logistics capacity planning.
  • Familiarity with logistics management software (WMS, TMS), ERP systems, and automation technologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage cost efficiency programs, including project pipeline management (PMO).
  • Expertise in identifying and implementing operational efficiency improvements and cost-saving initiatives.
  • Experience in applying process innovation to improve governance and operational performance.
  • Ability to prepare detailed analysis, graphics and reports to support and/or make presentations senior management.
  • Proven leadership skills with the ability to manage cross-functional teams and drive strategic initiatives.
  • Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams, internal and external partners.
  • Advanced Excel proficiency. Power BI is a Plus.
  • Fluent in English (mandatory).
  • Spanish proficiency (mandatory).

Our history is built on overcoming challenges and striving for excellence. Join us in pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation.

title: Pesquisador
description:
Faça parte da revolução na produtividade do canavial brasileiro e impulsione a bioenergia rumo a um mundo descarbonizado!

Estamos em busca de um Pesquisador (Fisiologia Vegetal) para compor o nosso time de P&D.

Essa posição é estratégica para conectar ciência de ponta à prática agrícola, aplicando conhecimentos avançados de fisiologia vegetal no desenvolvimento de tecnologias que impactam diretamente a produtividade e a sustentabilidade do cultivo.   • Investigar e testar novas tecnologias, como nanopartículas, bioestimulantes e soluções nutricionais aplicadas
  • Interpretar dados fisiológicos, bioquímicos e agronômicos para embasar decisões técnicas e recomendações
  • Produzir relatórios técnicos, apresentações e documentos científicos com alto rigor e clareza
  • Apoiar treinamentos, ações de transferência de tecnologia e possíveis publicações científicas
  • Promover a integração entre áreas técnicas e operacionais para aplicação prática das soluções desenvolvidas

Diferenciais:

  • Familiaridade com aplicações de nanotecnologia em agricultura
  • Experiência com bioinsumos ou soluções nutricionais inovadoras
  • Publicações científicas ou técnicas na área de fisiologia ou nutrição vegetal
  • Perfil proativo, analítico, colaborativo e orientado à inovação aplicada

Alta performance: Entregamos resultados de muito valor, com alto nível de excelência na execução.

Sucesso do Cliente: Por meio de nossas soluções, geramos valor e resultado para os nossos clientes. O cliente está no centro de nossas decisões e o sucesso dos nossos clientes é o nosso sucesso.

Se você é movido pela ciência, pela inovação e quer causar um impacto real, o CTC é o lugar certo para você. Candidate-se agora e seja parte dessa transformação! Junte-se a um time em pleno crescimento exponencial, onde seu desenvolvimento e crescimento profissional têm espaço para acontecer.
